title: extcap: Parse parameter indicating that we support control pipe
description:
Add a parameter "{control=%u}", to the extcap configuration indicating
the level of support for the control pipe. 0 indicates no control pipe,
1 indicates that it can receive SP_TOOLBAR_MSG messages only (the
previous behavior), and 2 indicates that it can also handle SP_QUIT
messages.

If missing, it defaults to 0, unless the configuration for the interface
mentions toolbar controls, in which case it defaults to 1 for backwards
compatibility. It can be set at the extcap version string top level,
in which case it will be used for all interfaces for that extcap unless
they have a different (nonzero) value, or it can be sent in the
interface string.

If the level is 2, then SP_QUIT messages will be sent on the control
pipe when exiting, allowing graceful shutdown on Windows. (Rude
termination will still happen if not all extcaps which are used for
simultaneous capture support SP_QUIT messages.)

Only sshdump uses this at the moment, but it's trivial to add the
other extcaps in the repo.

Fix #14239, #17131
